title: Running Through the Rewind Phase
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, $x$ a Boolean input, and $m$ a natural number. For any input-head position and work-tape contents and head positions, if a choice word $w$ has length $m+2$, then running the host machine from phase $	ext{rew}$ with the yard head at $m$ for $w$ steps ends in phase $	ext{run}$ with $A$ in its initial state and no captured output, with the yard head at $0$ and the input head at the position obtained by moving left $m+1$ steps and then right once; the other tape data and output are unchanged.
